en-US: Build 215 is a stability follow-up to the first TinyEMU release. Please retest local-model tool calls through a second continuation, cross-task lookup through a final answer, Git initialization, and concurrent terminal commands including cancelling a stuck command. Also check that switching tasks switches the IDE workspace, PDF and Office stay in IDE tabs, Chinese text renders, Command-S saves, and closing a changed document asks whether to save. Mind-map add controls are now compact icons and free-position dragging has been corrected. Native Python, Node, Ruby and other language payloads remain outside the app; install and run them in the Linux guest. This release uses focused checks and a cloud app build. Device performance and crash resolution remain for your acceptance.
zh-Hans: Build 215 是首个 TinyEMU 版本后的稳定性修复。请重点复测：本地模型调用工具并进入第二轮续写；跨任务检索直到输出最终答复；Git 初始化；多个任务同时运行终端命令，以及取消卡住的命令。还请检查切换任务时 IDE 工作区会同步切换；PDF 和 Office 留在 IDE 标签内；中文正常显示；Command-S 可保存；关闭有修改的文档会询问是否保存。思维导图的新增操作已改为紧凑图标，自由拖动坐标也已修正。原生 Python、Node、Ruby 等语言包仍不打进应用，请在 Linux 客体中安装运行。本版只做必要代码检查与云端 App 构建，真机性能和闪退是否消失由你验收。
